description: Consolidated RICH-SCHEMA CANDIDATE (development). NOT yet G2-approved production schema. Pending EXP-015b. Single English word entry, batch-friendly.

id.description: Unique input ID. Preserved exactly as received.

lemma.description: Target English word. Preserve spelling and casing exactly from input.

difficulty_score.description: Storage-compat decision: kept as string to match legacy DB TEXT contract. 1=concrete/basic, 10=abstract/nuanced.

ai_confidence.description: MODEL SELF-CONFIDENCE score (0.0-1.0), NOT a calibrated probability. Not statistically authoritative.

phonetic_us.description: American English IPA. NO slashes or brackets, e.g. əˈtʃiːv.

phonetic_uk.description: British English IPA, NO slashes. Null = same as US, not missing.

phonetic_ar.description: English pronunciation transliterated to Arabic script with HALF TASHKEEL.

definition_en.description: Clear, simple English explanation, max 20 words, high-frequency vocabulary, no target word, no circular definition.

explanation_ar.description: Natural Arabic explanation in modern standard Arabic across dialects, written as a teacher, not machine translation.

examples.description: Exactly 3 natural examples, each containing the exact target lemma as a standalone token.

example_text.description: Natural sentence containing the exact target lemma.

intended_cefr.description: CEFR band this example best demonstrates.

mnemonic_ar.description: Genuine memory retrieval hook in simple Arabic without tashkeel. English words in double quotes. Null is the default unless a strong hook passes the Counterfactual and Novelty tests. No parentheses () or brackets []. Never a paraphrase/translation.

senses.description: Distinct lexical senses. Fewer accurate senses than many redundant ones. Exactly-one-primary and sequential sense_no are SEMANTIC checks enforced by the validator, not this JSON Schema.

sense_no.description: Sequential integer starting at 1. Sequentiality enforced by validator.

definition_en.description: Simple explanation, max 20 words, no target word.

short_def_en.description: Core gloss / label, 2-6 words, not a truncation of definition_en.

definition_ar.description: White Arabic, no tashkeel, teacher-style explanation.

is_primary.description: Exactly one sense true; enforced by validator.

usage_note.description: Brief learner-relevant usage distinction. Empty string if none.

mnemonic_ar.description: Genuine retrieval hook for this sense. Usually null on secondary senses unless independently strong. Rules as entry-level mnemonic_ar.

collocations.description: 3-5 natural high-frequency pairings, e.g. achieve success.

antonyms.description: Up to 3 clear antonyms. Empty array if none.

en.description: Words in the same semantic field.

ar.description: Direct Arabic translations of the related English words.

noun.description: Noun form, empty string if none.

verb.description: Verb form, empty string if none.

adj.description: Adjective form, empty string if none.

adv.description: Adverb form, empty string if none.

translations.description: Multilingual translations. All fields required and non-null.

arabic_ar.description: Primary Arabic translation; separate distinct meanings with ' / '.

chinese_zh.description: Simplified Chinese + Pinyin in brackets, e.g. 你好 (Nǐ hǎo).

japanese_ja.description: Kanji/Kana + Romaji in brackets, e.g. 猫 (Neko).
